I found nothing to fix, and I haven't changed any files.

- **Visual comparison:** all 12 snapshots (6 pages, desktop and phone) differ from the baselines by only 0.07–0.20% of pixels. The differences are scattered sub-pixel changes at glyph edges. The DOM and computed styles match in every case, and fonts, stylesheets and images all loaded.
- **`orders__phone`:** this was the one snapshot flagged as a concentrated diff. I looked at the baseline, current and diff images. It is the same kind of glyph-edge difference (a few pixels in "Orders", the lede text, the table dates and the footer). Layout, spacing and colours are identical.
